summary: Backend API regression passed (11/11). Frontend core flows mostly pass: landing/docs/mobile, demo vault setup/unlock, encrypted memory create/view/edit, export/import validations, and lock behavior. One UI flow remains flaky around Developer 'Test a request' modal after API key flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure to open 'Test a request' modal after API key creation/disconnect sequence; selector [data-testid='test-api-key-input'] did not appear within timeout.

integration_issues.flow: Agent disconnect/reconnect + API key runtime verification via UI modal
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete end-to-end UI verification due to modal open flakiness. Backend API-level behavior is validated and passing in pytest.

action_items: Stabilize Developer > 'Test a request' modal opening behavior after API key operations and agent status toggles.
Main agent should self-retest reconnect scenario: disconnect revokes all permissions and reconnect does not restore prior grants (UI path).
Add/verify deterministic UI state reset for Developer tab/modal transitions to avoid flaky automation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is very large (>700 lines). Split into route/component scoped styles for maintainability and lower regression risk.
Developer page handles several modal/state paths in one component; consider extracting modal state logic to reduce UI race/flaky behavior.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated demo identities during tests via /api/auth/demo. No permanent seed script added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three Playwright runs executed. Stable passes: landing/docs/mobile no-overflow, demo vault create/unlock, encrypted memory create (no plaintext in POST payload), wrong passphrase rejection, correct decrypt/edit, private access warning, export schema validation, malformed/wrong-pass import failures, successful import re-encrypt, lock state. Unstable: Developer modal [data-testid='test-api-key-input'] intermittently not appearing after clicking [data-testid='test-api-request'] in API flow.
rca of the issue: Probable UI state/race issue in Developer page modal flow. Reproduction: create API key -> close secret modal -> click 'Test a request' (sometimes modal input does not render within timeout). Potential mitigation: ensure tab state remains 'Overview', debounce modal toggles, and add deterministic visibility guard before proceeding.
